data_source: Reticular Chemistry Structure Resource, https://rcsr.net (O'Keeffe, Peskov, Ramsden and Yaghi, Acc. Chem. Res. 41, 1782, 2008). Not redistributed. Download the files below into one directory and pass it with --rcsr DIR or RCSR_DIR.

rcsr3d.cgd.note: Systre cgd file of the RCSR nets (also distributed as RCSRnets-2019-06-01.cgd); read by every RCSR-based script

3dall.txt.note: RCSR 3D data file with tiling symbols; read by screen/coordination.py
